meaning:
ἐξ-ανίσημι
[in LXX chiefly for קוּם ;]
1. trans., to raise up: σπέρμα (cf. Gen.38:8), Mrk.12:19, Luk.20:28.
2. In 2 aor. act., intrans., to rise: Act.15:5.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise…
They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up…
But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, “It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.”
